english.title: Fail to comply with requirement made by food crime officer
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT..), made of you by a food crime officer, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), who was acting in the exercise of functions conferred on the officer by virtue of section 114C of the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25A(1)(b) of the Food Standards Act 1999.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Food crime officers are certain officers of the Food Standards Agency, for details see section 114C of the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984.
